cast.name: 比安卡·布克霍尔茨 Bianca Buchholtz

introduction: After the death of her father and discovering her husband's infidelity, high-powered executive Kendall (Bianca Buckholtz) drowns her sorrows in a bar-where she meets the charming but mysterious Raymond (Sam Gousheh). Their one-night stand seems like a fleeting escape, until Raymond unknowingly lands a job as Kendall's assistant, tasked with spying on her company by his father. As secrets unravel, passion reignites and betrayals come to light. What begins as corporate espionage quickly spirals into a tangled web of lies, kidnapping, and high-stakes power plays. In the end, both must decide who they really are-and whether love can survive in a world built on deception.—CindySorley
